title: Mission Control: AI Adaptive Loop Panel showing Iteration Chain and Hypotheses
goal: When a run uses run_mode=ai_loop, Mission Control must replace or augment the current Phase Chain panel with an AI Loop panel that shows: (1) current iteration number and loop status; (2) the last AI hypothesis (what the AI decided to try next and why); (3) the chain of findings-to-actions so far (finding confirmed → pivot context created → next tool queued); (4) what is queued next and why; (5) a clear label 'AI Adaptive Pentest — exploiting confirmed findings automatically'. For standard/chain runs the existing Phase Chain panel remains unchanged. The data comes from existing AgentReasoning records (reasoning_type='assessment_loop_next_action') and the run's configuration_json.assessment_loop state. No new API endpoints needed — use existing /api/v1/runs/{id}/ai-insights and /api/v1/agent-reasoning endpoints.
generation_reason: Mission Control shows 'No chain' for ai_loop runs because it only renders assessment chain data. The operator has no visibility into what the AI is doing, what it found, and what it plans next.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.no_new_endpoints: Use existing API endpoints. Do not add new backend routes.
constraints.no_breaking_changes: Standard run and chain run views must remain unchanged.
constraints.ts_clean: npm run build in ui-v2/ must pass with no TypeScript errors.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.detection: Check run.configuration_json?.run_mode === 'ai_loop' to decide which panel to show.
implementation_notes.loop_state: Loop state is in run.configuration_json.assessment_loop — shows status, iteration_count, stop_reason, last_action.
implementation_notes.reasoning_chain: Fetch from run.ai_mission_guidance or via getRunAiInsights(). The proposals array contains the loop iterations with reasoning_text and next_action.
implementation_notes.panel_layout: Replace Phase Chain panel with AI Loop panel for ai_loop runs. Show: status badge, iteration counter, last hypothesis card, next action card, mini-chain timeline.
implementation_notes.chain_timeline: Each loop proposal = one row: [tool icon] [target] [reasoning summary] [status: queued/running/completed]

acceptance_criteria: For ai_loop run: Phase Chain panel replaced with 'AI Adaptive Loop' panel showing iteration count and last hypothesis.
For standard/chain run: existing Phase Chain panel unchanged.
The panel updates when Mission Control polls (every 3 seconds).
The panel shows 'stopped' with reason when the loop terminates.
